title: Glioma_1_PBMC_GEX
extract_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) were isolated from whole blood by Ficoll-Hyapque density gradient centrifugation. Freshly resected glioma tumors were mechanically disrupted and the resulting tissue fragments were digested with 50 mg/mL of Liberase DL  in 5 mL of serum-free RPMI for 15 minutes at 37°C. Live CD45+ (i.e. all live immune cells) were sorted from PBMC and glioma tissues. Single-cell RNAseq was performed using 10X Genomics and libraries were sequenced on Illuman NovaSeq6000 instruments.

The library generation strategy was as per the manufacturer's instructions for either 10X Genomics 3' or 5' based chemistries for a given sample. For some samples, cell hashing was performed to run the PBMC and tumor infiltrating leukocytes (TIL) in the same lane of the 10X Chip. For these samples, oligonucleotide-labeled antibodies were used to label PBMC and TIL and as specified for each sample. Cell hashing libraries were generated as per the 10X Genomics manufacturer's instructions.
data_processing: Demultiplexing was performed using bcl2fastq v2.20.0.
Gene expression libraries were aligned to GRCh38 using CellRanger v6.1.2. CITEseq libraries were aligned to hash tag sequences using CITEseqCount v1.4.3.
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-delimited barcodes, features, and matrix files
contact_address: The Assembly, Room 4070C Bay 10, 5051 Centre Ave

metadata.source_identity_policy: Exact original Glioma participant code and PBMC-only tissue label. Separate tumor captures from the same person are not additional blood samples. Mixed PBMC/TIL captures require published compartment assignments and remain separate leads.
metadata.source_selection_policy: Ficoll-isolated PBMC followed by live CD45 sorting. Separate RNA capture only; no whole mixed blood/tumor geometry and no protein-count normalization.
metadata.source_time_policy: Primary manuscript states PBMC collected after intubation and before preoperative steroids. Retain as cohort-level sampling context; exact individual dates and prior therapy not inferred.
metadata.source_metadata_policy: Original tumor grade and IDH status retained. Individual age/sex and exclusion from final paper cohort not joined. GEO19participants versus primary18analyzed/15pairedPBMC/eighthealthy controls not silently reconciled.
metadata.source_reference_policy: Preserve native original RNA genes and identifiers; chemistry differs across the broader study. These four records explicitly state 3-prime v2 chemistry.
metadata.split_assignment: unassigned; no discovery model or donor split fitted
